context: Hybrid fullstack mobile-first web app for local business owners and their customers

audience: local business owners with limited time and technical confidence
customers leaving a quick Google review on mobile
primary_tasks: sign up and configure business profile
generate and manage 20 natural review drafts
share a public review link or QR code
copy a selected draft and finish on Google
success_actions: customer copies a draft and clicks through to Google
phase_1_discovery.emotional_tone: clean, credible, calm momentum; generous enough to feel premium but practical enough for a busy owner
phase_1_discovery.theme: light-first with optional dark mode reserved for future settings; the public flow stays light for trust and speed
fusion: print-shop proof sheets for the review drafts
wayfinding signage and blue ink for local trust

design_directions.name: Blue Proof Sheet
design_directions.description: A crisp editorial dashboard where review drafts feel like stamped copy proofs; cobalt blue signals action, warm paper surfaces signal humanity.

design_directions.name: Local Signal
design_directions.description: Wayfinding-inspired UI with oversized directional labels, route lines, and a QR/share module that feels like a storefront sign.

design_directions.name: Quiet Counter
design_directions.description: A restrained café-counter aesthetic: ink blue, bone white, small receipt-like metadata, and soft physical shadows.

design_directions.name: Review Radio
design_directions.description: A more expressive option using broadcast-style numbered drafts and a live frequency motif without neon or gradients.

design_directions.name: Neighborhood Ledger
design_directions.description: A compact ledger language with visible grid rules, mono metadata, and blue as functional color only.

references.descriptor: Position review growth as a guided action rather than a passive analytics dashboard; keep human oversight visible.
Use a setup progress state, meaningful empty states, and a clear next-best action so the first dashboard is never blank.
Retain the clean minimal composition, pale background, dark ink typography, compact mono labels, and generous whitespace; replace mint/coral accents with a more ownable blue system.

research.note: The supplied reference is a JPEG asset and could not be text-scraped; its visual direction is captured from the problem statement and existing prototype CSS.

typography.heading: Manrope 800/700, tight tracking
rules: H1 max text-6xl; dashboard hero should use text-5xl or clamp equivalent
never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings
headings leading-none or tight; body leading-relaxed

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with warm paper tint
colors.rule: Use blue only for CTA, active states, links, focus, and progress. No full-screen gradient. Never use pure black or neutral gray; retain blue-tinted neutrals.

visual_enhancers: subtle paper grain/noise overlay at 3-5% opacity
layered ambient and direct shadows only on interactive surfaces
small blue registration marks and numbered labels as decorative details
custom scrollbar with tinted thumb and no gutter

grids.dashboard: High-density responsive grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 to gap-6; summary metrics span 1, main setup/drafts span 2, share module spans 1 row-span-2.
grids.marketing_or_auth: Tetris split: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 with art/statement spanning 7-8 columns and form spanning 4-5; do not center everything.
grids.public: Single narrow reading column, max-w-xl, left-aligned heading and full-width selectable draft rows.
grids.spacing: Use p-6/p-8 inside bordered containers, py-16 to py-24 between major sections, mobile-first.
grids.alignment: Grid items are direct children; use align-items-start; only stretch cards that need equal bottoms.

owner_dashboard: solid or crystal-glass header with ReviewBoost logo, Dashboard, Drafts, Share links, Settings, and account CTA/menu visible on desktop
intro row with setup status and lifetime generation counter
asymmetric workspace: profile setup left, QR/link share right
draft manager below with numbered rows, reorder affordance, edit/delete, and Generate 20 drafts CTA
empty states explain value and provide one next action
public_review_page: no-login, fast-loading page with business name and short instruction
20 numbered draft rows with copy action and selected state
prominent finish on Google action after clipboard copy
small trust/privacy note and no distracting navigation
auth: desktop split layout with editorial statement and form; mobile stacks art above form
email/password and Google auth use Shadcn Input/Button primitives, customized to brand

motion.entrance: stagger dashboard sections by 60ms with opacity and translateY only
motion.hover: buttons lift 2px; draft rows lift 1px and strengthen border; explicit hover text colors
motion.clipboard: brief blue check state and Sonner success toast after copy
motion.loading: skeleton rows or a restrained pulsing proof mark while generating
motion.reduced_motion: disable transforms, stagger, and decorative motion under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.implementation: Use specific transitions such as transition-transform, transition-colors, transition-opacity; never transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Meet WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text; verify blue buttons use white text.
accessibility.focus: Visible 2px blue focus ring with offset on every control.
accessibility.keyboard: All draft selection, copy, reorder, delete, QR download, and Google redirect actions keyboard reachable with clear labels.
accessibility.semantics: Use buttons for actions, links for navigation, labels for every input, aria-live for generation/copy status.
accessibility.testing: Every interactive and key informational element must include a stable kebab-case data-testid, for example review-draft-copy-button, dashboard-usage-counter, public-google-redirect-link.
accessibility.privacy: Public page exposes only configured business name, keywords/drafts, and required Google destination; never expose owner identity or auth data.

media.strategy: No stock photography is necessary; the product is content-led and must remain fast. Use CSS paper texture, QR rendering, and tiny inline SVG marks only.

image_categories.hero: none; use layered paper and registration marks
image_categories.logos: use actual configured business logo only if provided by owner; never invent placeholder logos

3d_libraries.reason: This product needs clarity and speed, not immersion; 3D would distract from the copy/redirect task.

implementation_instructions.framework: React JS, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, existing Shadcn primitives.
implementation_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox and Dialog logic; do not build advanced interactions from native select/date inputs.
implementation_instructions.notifications: Use Sonner from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or the existing project equivalent.
implementation_instructions.header: Every page has a visible branded navigation/header with a non-transparent solid or blurred background; add content offset if sticky.
implementation_instructions.security: Treat review generation as server-side; validate business data and keywords, rate-limit generation, sanitize drafts, protect owner routes, and ensure public IDs are non-guessable.
implementation_instructions.mocked_integrations: AI generation, Google OAuth, Google redirect destination, QR generation, and clipboard behavior must be clearly handled by the real backend/browser APIs where available; do not present MOCKED integrations as complete.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Avoid generic centered layouts, excessive gradients, and uniform equal cards.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default instincts; preserve negative space.
Use layered depth, crisp borders, tinted neutrals, and restrained texture.
Every interactive element needs hover, active, focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Never use emoji characters as icons; use existing icon library or inline SVG.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds behind content; use solid or blurred scrims.
Keep public customer flow one-handed, fast, and obvious: choose draft, copy, finish on Google.
Avoid dark colors as gradients; use flat dark surfaces if dark mode is added.

definition_of_done: mobile layout tested at 320px and desktop at 1440px
clipboard and redirect states are explicit
